reviews.comment: Love her! Made assignments clear and straightforward and had lots of opportunities for credit. This class was fairly easy and never stressful. She is very accessible outside of class and truly wants you do make a good grade in the class. Kind of a hard grader on essays, but nothing outrageous. Take her!
Professor Bourjeaurd is amazing! She knows how to make the material enjoyable and fun. She really works to help students improve their writing skills and process. Take her if you can!
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--So many papers

reviews.comment: ENGL 203. Professor Bourjeaurd is a wonderful teacher and very kind. She is clearly passionate about the books we read and does an excellent job making the course material engaging. She is very understanding of students' schedules and offers a helpful grace period for assignments, which are manageable and well-paced.

I was annoyed that I had to take this class but it ended up being my favorite. A lot of the material is pretty boring but Prof B tried to make it as fun with class stuff like a debate to learn thesis statements. She actually gives feedback that makes sense and clearly wants you to get better at writing and it helped me do better in other classes
